metadata.case_name: LAU PAI YAM BOTTOMLEY v. TAI TUNG COFFEE CO LTD

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: driver (not requiring lifting), chauffeur, messenger or carpark attendant

injuries.description: fractures to his 2nd and 3rd metatarsal bones.
source: an X-ray revealed the fractures to his 2nd and 3rd metatarsal bones.

injuries.description: deformed base of the 3rd metatarsal bone which was obviously due to mal-union of the fracture
source: the X-ray had revealed deformed base of the 3rd metatarsal bone which was obviously due to mal-union of the fracture

injuries.description: post-traumatic arthritis of the tarso-metatarsal joints of the right foot
source: pain arising from post-traumatic arthritis of the tarso-metatarsal joints of the right foot
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

injuries.description: adjustment disorder with prolonged depressive reaction
source: provisionally diagnosed as suffering from adjustment disorder with prolonged depressive reaction.
In the middle of 2001, the Plaintiff started to suffer from low back pain.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia or tendon of abdomen, lower back or pelvis, unspecified

manifestations.description: severe episodic attacks of pain in his right leg each day
numbness and pain and a feeling of lack of strength in his foot
being unable to sit for more than 2 minutes
symptoms of anxiety and hyperventilation at times; emotional and moody
genuinely believing himself to be a sick person ("the sick role") for 4 years
mild muscle wasting over his right calf muscle
local tenderness and swelling over dorsum of right 3rd and 4th metatarsals
mild bilateral hallus valgas deformity with slight retraction of right 3rd and 4th toes
radiating pain over the dorsum of his right foot after walking for about 30 minutes
asked for amputation (indication of severity of pain)

treatments_received: admitted to United Christian Hospital and placed in plaster cast
plaster cast replaced by a splint
clinical paddings and custom made insoles
referral to Haven of Hope Hospital for chronic pain rehabilitation
referral to the Psychiatric Service of UCH
consultations with orthopaedic surgeons (Dr Lau Hoi Kuen and Dr Danny Tsoi)
treatments_future: more intensive psychiatric/psychological treatment recommended by Dr Chen for a further 6 months (3 visits to a psychologist per month at $3,000 per hour)

losses.description: Pain, Suffering and Loss of Amenities $300,000
